posts.preview: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations, chaired by Hon. Justina Jonas, today engaged the Mineworkers Union of Namibia (MUN) and employee representatives from diamond cutting and polishing companies on a petition calling for an investigation into the industry.

The petition was tabled in the National Assembly by Hon. Jonas on 23 April 2026 and referred to the Committee for consideration.
